input: Coordinate meal train for a friend post-surgery

gold.taskTitle: Coordinate post-surgery meal train for a friend
gold.taskDescription: Organize a meal train to provide regular meals to a friend who is recovering from surgery.

questions.title: What is your friend's surgery or recovery start date?
questions.description: Understanding the timeline helps determine when the meal train needs to begin.

questions.title: How many weeks should the meal train run?
questions.description: Knowing the desired duration helps plan the number of meal slots needed.

questions.title: How many people are in your friend's household to feed?
questions.description: This affects portion sizes and the complexity of each meal delivery.

questions.title: Are there any dietary restrictions or food allergies to note?
questions.description: Critical for ensuring all delivered meals are safe and appropriate for your friend.

questions.title: How many volunteers do you expect to recruit?
questions.description: Knowing the pool of helpers determines how to structure and space the meal slots.

questions.title: What platform will you use to manage sign-ups?
questions.description: For example, MealTrain.com, SignUpGenius, a group chat, or a spreadsheet.

questions.title: What is your preferred meal delivery time each day?
questions.description: A consistent drop-off window makes coordination easier for all volunteers.
